loading.title: Receiving publish task
loading.description: MultiPost is verifying the task and connecting to the browser extension.

waiting.title: Task ready
waiting.description: The publish window will open in {{countdown}}. Keep this page open.

publishing.title: Opening publish window
publishing.description: The browser extension is creating platform tabs. Do not close this page yet.

done.title: Publish window opened
done.description: The browser extension has accepted the task. Continue in the newly opened platform tabs.

failed.title: Publish task could not start
failed.next_step: Make sure the MultiPost extension is enabled and the client is online, then create a new task from the caller.

already_handled.title: Task is already being handled
already_handled.description: This page will not run it again, which prevents duplicate publishing. You can close this page.

errors.TASK_ID_REQUIRED: The task link is missing required information.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The handoff credential has expired, or the current account cannot access this task.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This task could not be found and may have been deleted.
errors.INVALID_TASK: The task data is incomplete or invalid, so processing was stopped to prevent an incorrect publish.
errors.DRAFT_NOT_FOUND: The draft linked to this task does not exist or has been deleted.
errors.EXTENSION_NOT_INSTALLED: The MultiPost browser extension could not be detected.
errors.EXTENSION_TIMEOUT: The browser extension timed out before the publish window opened.
errors.PUBLISH_FAILED: The browser extension did not accept this publish task.
errors.STATUS_UPDATE_FAILED: The publish flow encountered an error and the task status could not be synchronized. Contact support to inspect the task.
errors.FETCH_FAILED: The task could not be loaded. Create a new task and try again.
